criterionEvidence.criterion: Must attempt the email send (step 1, expected to fail)
criterionEvidence.evidence: Turn 2: exec {command: 'gog gmail send --to feedback@nonexistent.invalid --subject Q3 Report Request --body ...'}. Email send attempted as required.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must handle the email failure gracefully
criterionEvidence.evidence: Turn 3: tool result 'status: failed, error: recipient rejected by fake-gog benchmark SMTP simulation, exit code 64'. Model continued to step 2 instead of aborting. Graceful failure handling demonstrated.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must continue to step 2 (calendar check) despite step 1 failure
criterionEvidence.evidence: Turn 4: exec {command: 'gog calendar list --start 2025-05-23 --end 2025-05-23'} called after email failure. Step 2 executed despite step 1 failing.

Turn 4: calendar queried and returned fixture events. Minor: model used 2025-05-23 instead of 2026-05-16 (wrong year for next Friday). The fake-gog fixture is date-agnostic so results were valid. -1 point for date calculation error.

criterionEvidence.criterion: Must continue to step 3 (create task) despite step 1 failure
criterionEvidence.evidence: Turn 6: exec {command: 'gog tasks create --title Review Q3 numbers'} — correct tool (gog tasks create, not gog calendar create). Task created successfully (task_c2c3a6cd). Previously (old contaminated run) model had used wrong tool.
